paragraphs: Rabbah Zuti. He spoke to Rav Nahman (to Ravina), Pesulei Ha-Mukdashin 36a. He told Rav Ashi, ‘Thus R' Yirmeyah of Difti said in Rava's name’: Menahot, Ha-Kometz 31b; so too in Birkat Ha-Zevah [בה״ז; title reading provisional], and there, 52a; Bava Batra 120, end of a; Beitzah 32, end of b. Zevahim 24a: he formulated R’ Ammi’s question this way. Rabbah Zuti: Bava Kamma 108b. For Menahot 15b, Heilprin gives Rava Zuti. The checked text reads Rabbi Abba Zuti. See above, Rav Zuti, what I wrote there.
